orientation.instructions: Which way is the printed text in `bill` turned?

criteria.upright: The text reads normally, left to right.
criteria.top_points_right: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the right edge.
criteria.top_points_left: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the left edge.

weigh_bill.instructions: Is `bill` a weighbridge bill (a weighment slip)?

criteria.true: A printed slip from a weighbridge that records a vehicle's weight, such as gross, tare and net weight.
criteria.false: Any other document or photo, including a handwritten note or tally, or a receipt or invoice that records no vehicle weight.

slip_kind.instructions: If `bill` is a weighbridge slip, which weights are filled in on it?

criteria.one_weight: Only one weight, from the first weighing; the other weight and the net weight are blank or zero.
criteria.both_weights: Both weights (gross and tare, loaded and empty, or first and second), and the net weight.
criteria.not_shown: It isn't a weighbridge slip, or its weights can't be read.

bill_number.instructions: Is the vehicle number printed on `bill` the same as `vehicle_number`? The bill may label it Vehicle No, Truck No or Lorry No. Compare only the letters and digits, ignoring spaces, hyphens, dots, line breaks and letter case. They are the same only if every letter and digit matches, in the same order.

criteria.different: The bill shows a vehicle number, and at least one of its letters or digits differs from `vehicle_number`, or is missing or extra.
criteria.same: The bill shows a vehicle number with the same letters and digits as `vehicle_number`, in the same order.
criteria.not_shown: No vehicle number is printed on the bill, or it can't be read well enough to compare.

net_weight.instructions: Is the net weight printed on `bill` the same as `quantity_kg` kilograms? The bill may label it Net Weight, Net Wt, Net or Difference. Compare the number of kilograms only, ignoring leading zeros, spaces, thousands separators and the unit. They are the same only if the numbers are equal.

criteria.different: The bill shows a net weight, and it is a different number of kilograms from `quantity_kg`.
criteria.same: The bill shows a net weight of exactly `quantity_kg` kilograms.
criteria.not_shown: No net weight is printed on the bill, or it can't be read well enough to compare.

gross_vs_tare.instructions: If `bill` labels a gross (loaded) weight and a tare (empty) weight, which is the larger number?

criteria.gross_heavier: The weight labelled gross is larger than the weight labelled tare.
criteria.tare_heavier: The weight labelled tare is larger than the weight labelled gross.
criteria.not_shown: The bill doesn't label both a gross and a tare weight, or they can't be read.

gross_hour.instructions: If `bill` prints a date and time for the gross (loaded) weight itself, next to or under it, what hour is that time, exactly as printed? If AM or PM is printed after it, give the hour as printed, from 01 to 12. Ignore any timestamp on a camera picture printed on the slip.

criteria.not_shown: The bill prints no such time, or it can't be read.

gross_minute.instructions: If `bill` prints a date and time for the gross (loaded) weight itself, next to or under it, what minute is that time? Ignore any timestamp on a camera picture printed on the slip.

criteria.not_shown: The bill prints no such time, or it can't be read.

gross_ampm.instructions: If `bill` prints a date and time for the gross (loaded) weight itself, next to or under it, is AM or PM printed after that time? Ignore any timestamp on a camera picture printed on the slip.

criteria.none: Neither: the time is on a 24-hour clock, such as 15:06.
criteria.am: AM is printed after the time.
criteria.pm: PM is printed after the time.
criteria.not_shown: The bill prints no such time, or it can't be read.

first_weight.instructions: Which weight on `bill` was taken first, at the Time In (the first weighment)?

criteria.tare: The tare (empty) weight: the bill shows it with the Time In, or labels it the first weight.
criteria.gross: The gross (loaded) weight: the bill shows it with the Time In, or labels it the first weight.
criteria.not_shown: The bill has no Time In, or doesn't show which weight was taken first.
